profile.summary: A nonprofit based in Oakland, California, that supports children's well-being through access to nutritious meals, quality reading resources and chances to play and be active. It works with schools on food, literacy tutoring and sports, and renovates school spaces such as schoolyards, cafeterias, libraries and gyms.

sources.title: Eat Learn Play Foundation - Nonprofit Explorer - ProPublica

review.notes: The agenda names 'Eat.Learn.Play Foundation, Oakland, CA' as a grantor for food/garden and academic programming. The organization's site and ProPublica both show an Oakland 501(c)(3) with EIN 83-1373602 whose school-based food, literacy and play work fits those grants. The summary and contact fields are supported by the cited pages and are neutral. Neither page names OUSD directly, but the name, city and program fit leave no real doubt.
